camel_example: aliyun esa ListRedirectRules --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 123456000000 --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --ConfigId 352816096980000 --ConfigType rule --SiteVersion 0 --RuleName rule_example
description_en: Queries the redirect configuration list of a site
description_zh: 查询站点的重定向配置列表
kebab_example: aliyun esa list-redirect-rules --site-id 123456000000 --config-id 352816096980000 --config-type rule --rule-name rule_example --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --site-version 0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListRedirectRules

parameters.help_en: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The configuration type. Valid values:
global: global configuration.
rule: rule configuration
parameters.help_zh:
配置类型。取值范围：
global：全局配置。
rule：规则配置
parameters.name: config_type

parameters.help_en: The rule name. You can use this parameter to query the rule whose name matches the specified value
parameters.help_zh: 规则名，可以查出规则名为所传字段的那条规则
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en: The page number for a paged query. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的页码。取值大于等于 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的大小，取值范围 1-500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version
